verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llama.cpp's source is public on GitHub and can be read: users can clone and build it, contributors can open PRs, and community members report compiling from source. However, nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license, which is half the story. missing for 10: explicit open-license evidence (e.g. MIT/LICENSE file), independent corroboration of license terms
